form.notes: Form-associated (`ElementInternals`): submits `name=14:30` (an empty string when empty) whatever the language, resets to the `value` attribute, restores on navigation, works with `form=` and `label for`, and joins `<fieldset disabled>`. `required` (valueMissing), `min`/`max` (rangeUnderflow / rangeOverflow) and text that is not a time (badInput) block the submit; the error shows after the user acted or a submit attempt, and unreadable text once typing pauses.

differences.text: Uncontrolled by default (D-006): `value` is a plain string with the `value` attribute as its default (a form reset restores it), and native `input`/`change` events report a committed change instead of a controlled `value` plus `onChange`. Nothing fires for a property or attribute write.

Typed text is a draft that commits when the entry ends (Enter, leaving the field), not on every keystroke that reads as a time ("2" is 2:00): see DATEINPUT-02. A step is a discrete commit (`input` then `change`), announced through the shared announcer.

Text that is not a time, or a time outside `min`/`max`, is `validity.badInput`, `aria-invalid` and announced once assertively after typing pauses (`@tct.timeInput.invalidTime`), instead of an always-mounted `role=alert` node.

Typed text also reads the locale's own digits and AM/PM markers (`٢:٣٠ م`, `下午2:30`) and the closed value shows them; `min`/`max` are constraints on a programmatic value too (rangeUnderflow, rangeOverflow).

The bottom sheet holds hour, minute, second and AM/PM columns (`tct-time-panel`: listboxes with roving focus that commit live, options no time in `min`..`max` can produce disabled) and a Save button that only closes it; upstream's scroll wheels are not reproduced. An `open` property and the cancelable `tct-open-change` / `tct-after-open-change` events expose the sheet; `tct-clear` is cancelable. `hasAutoFocus` is the global `autofocus` attribute.

Outlined field from the Tecton input tokens with a decorative clock; the sheet columns use the primary action fill for the picked option, the tertiary roles for hover and focus, and the disabled text role for options outside the window.

core.time-input.notes: Guides: [mwg:model-partial-time-concepts] a wall-clock time of day, no date and no zone; [mwg:validate-input-after-interaction]; [mwg:form-associated-custom-elements]; [mwg:ime-safe-enter-submit] IME-safe Enter and arrows; [mwg:accessible-error-announcement]. `tct-time-panel` (in `date-input/`) is the internal helper element of the touch sheet.
